definition: binary flag set when base_identity exactly matches one of the chronic-6 subjects from Job 11 (analysis/job_11_identity_audit_2026-05-04/). The Job 11 cohort is at tau@FPR=10% on teams_real_all_dev; an identity is 'chronic' if it appears in the worst-FPR table across at least one ckpt.
match_rule: row.base_identity in chronic_list, OR (case-insensitive substring match of any chronic-6 identity inside base_identity) — captures suffixed variants like 'PC_Generator__s22__seg_5.0__real'.
